_doc: Presets for `python3 -m scout find <preset>`: targeted on-demand searches for one garment type. categories limit the pool; require = the item must look like this garment (regex on title/type/tags/description); confirm = phrases that confirm the specific detail; reject = phrases that rule it out. Items matching neither confirm nor reject are kept as 'unconfirmed' so Claude can check the photo. Add presets freely.
